analyses.long_business_summary: Saizeriya Co.,Ltd. operates restaurants in Japan, Australia, Indonesia and Asia. It operates Italian wine and cafe restaurants under the Saizeriya brand name. Saizeriya Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Yoshikawa, Japan.
